services.title: Auto Insurance

services.lead: Accidents happen, so make sure you are covered. Our extensive group of national partners lets us offer some of the best discounts available today, and we quote your auto insurance over the phone.

covers.title: Discounts

questions.q: What auto insurance discounts can I get?
questions.a: The discounts we have available include anti-theft devices, anti-lock brakes, multi-policy, multi-car, longevity, payment plan, safe driver, youthful driver, college student, driver training, an auto accident prevention course, reduced usage, passive restraints and age 55 or over.

questions.q: Can I insure a boat or a motorcycle with you?
questions.a: Yes. We quote ATVs, boats, motorcycles and jet skis. Bundling everything saves you money and lets you make one payment on all your property.

services.title: Homeowner's Insurance
services.summary: Homes, condos, renters and mobile homes.
services.text: Your home is a huge investment. We write homeowner's, condo, renter's and mobile home policies so you can rebuild or replace if something happens.
services.lead: Natural disasters can wreak havoc on a house. Protecting your investment means that if an unfortunate event occurs, you and your family have what you need to rebuild or replace.
services.imageAlt: A two-story house with black shutters

covers.title: Fire and lightning
covers.text: Damage from fire, lightning and explosions to the house and what is inside it.

covers.title: Hail and theft
covers.text: Hail damage and theft, among the other tragedies a homeowner's policy is written to cover.

covers.title: Renter's and condo
covers.text: If you are not a homeowner quite yet, renter's insurance covers your belongings at your apartment, and we write condo policies as well.

covers.title: Mobile homes
covers.text: Mobile home policies that can include physical damage, personal liability, theft, flood and more.

questions.q: Does my homeowner's policy cover flooding?
questions.a: No. Flooding needs a separate policy in addition to your home insurance. See our flood page or call 281-464-3443.
Yes. Homes come in all shapes and sizes, and we have various options available for mobile homes. We will show you all your options so you can make the best decision for your needs.

services.lead: Your homeowner policy does not cover flooding. If you want your home protected from flood damage, you need a separate policy in addition to your home insurance.
services.imageAlt: A flooded street with a road sign standing in the water

covers.title: NFIP policies
covers.text: Flood coverage written through the National Flood Insurance Program.

covers.title: Policies through our partners
covers.text: Flood coverage through one of our many national insurance partners.

covers.title: 24/7 claims support

covers.title: A dedicated agent
covers.text: An agent who can help you understand your flood coverage, and help finding discounts to maximize your savings.

questions.q: Does flood insurance cover backed up water?
questions.a: Not all flood policies cover backed up water, for example water that backs up from sewers or drains. We want to make sure you understand all of your options and all aspects of your coverage.

questions.q: Do I need a property policy with you to buy flood insurance?
questions.a: No. Though the government determines flood insurance coverage and premiums, you can still purchase your flood policy through our agency even if you do not have an existing property policy with us.

services.title: Life Insurance
services.text: Term and whole life coverage so your family is not left with the effects of losing your contribution to the household income.
services.lead: Life insurance is a financial instrument that lets you protect your family and loved ones when you pass away. There are two major types, term and whole life, and we help you choose a policy that fits your individual needs.
services.imageAlt: An older woman and a young boy standing together at a table

covers.title: Term life
covers.text: The simplest form of life insurance. It pays only if death occurs during the term of the policy, usually from one to 30 years.

covers.title: Level term
covers.text: The death benefit stays the same throughout the duration of the policy.

covers.title: Decreasing term
covers.text: The death benefit drops, usually in one-year increments, over the course of the policy's term.

covers.title: Whole and permanent life
covers.text: Pays a death benefit whenever you die, even if you live to 100, with both the benefit and the premium designed to stay level.

questions.q: What is the cash value on a whole life policy?
questions.a: A whole life premium is held level by charging more than is needed in the early years and investing it. By law, once those overpayments reach a certain amount they must be available to you as a cash value if you decide not to continue with the original plan. It is an alternative benefit under the policy rather than an additional one.

questions.q: Why buy life insurance at all?
questions.a: So your family does not have to uproot their lives and change their living standards in the event of a premature or unexpected death.

services.title: Health Insurance
services.text: Help finding a health plan that fits your budget and lifestyle, including the move onto Medicare at 65.
services.lead: We understand how confusing the health insurance landscape can be. Call us for help in determining the right fit for your budget and your lifestyle.
services.imageAlt: A stethoscope held in a clinician's hands

covers.title: Preparing for the unexpected
covers.text: If you need medical attention, testing or surgery unexpectedly, the cost could be extremely expensive. You never know when you will need medical help.

covers.title: Preventive services
covers.text: Many preventive services, like physical exams or checkups, are covered at 100%.

covers.title: Medicare
covers.text: If you are 65 or over, or a person with certain disabilities, we can help you understand your options as you transition from employer insurance onto Medicare.

questions.q: Can you help me work out which Medicare program I qualify for?
questions.a: Yes. If you have questions about the different Medicare programs and whether or not you qualify, contact our office at 281-464-3443.

questions.q: Why own health insurance if I am healthy?
questions.a: One reason is to prepare for the unexpected, and another is to stay healthy, since many preventive services like checkups are covered at 100%.

services.lead: If you own a business, you need insurance that covers everything from employees to the building and the vehicles used for business purposes. Every business is different and may have different risks, so we provide custom coverage built around yours.
services.imageAlt: Racks of clothing in a retail shop

covers.title: General liability
covers.text: Protection against the things that happen to a business, from a slip and fall to a burglary.

covers.title: Property and contents
covers.text: Your building and what is in it, including fire, water and freezing, hail and strong wind damage.

covers.title: Worker's comp
covers.text: Coverage for your employees when something happens on the job.

covers.title: Business auto
covers.text: The vehicles used for business purposes, written on a commercial policy rather than a personal one.

covers.title: Business interruption
covers.text: Cover for the income lost while your business is unable to trade.

questions.q: What kinds of businesses do you write?
questions.a: We provide custom coverage for many different types of businesses, including construction, manufacturing, moving companies, Main Street retail and office, restaurants, trucking, churches and non-emergency medical transportation.
If you have questions about commercial insurance or bonds, call the office at 281-464-3443.
